mapper.sql: SELECT r.review_id, r.order_id, r.role, r.reviewer_id, r.reviewee_id, r.product_id, r.overall_score, r.content, r.images, r.tags, r.anonymous, r.status, r.tenant_id, r.create_time, CASE WHEN r.anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名用户' ELSE u.nick_name END reviewer_nick_name, CASE WHEN r.anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.avatar END reviewer_avatar FROM trade_review r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.reviewer_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_review (order_id, role, reviewer_id, reviewee_id, product_id, overall_score, content, images, tags, anonymous, status, create_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{role}, #{reviewerId}, #{revieweeId}, #{productId}, #{overallScore}, #{content}, #{images}, #{tags}, #{anonymous}, 'normal', sysdate() , #{tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, ROUND(AVG(r.overall_score), 1) AS avgScore FROM trade_review r WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.role = 'buyer' AND r.status = 'normal' AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, ROUND(AVG(r.overall_score), 1) AS avgScore, SUM(CASE WHEN r.overall_score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCount FROM trade_review r WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{revieweeId} AND r.role = 'buyer' AND r.status = 'normal' AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.sql: SELECT r.review_id, r.order_id, r.role, r.reviewer_id, r.reviewee_id, r.product_id, r.overall_score + 0 overall_score, r.content, r.images, r.tags, r.anonymous, r.status, r.create_time, u.nick_name reviewer_nick_name, u.avatar reviewer_avatar, o.order_no, p.title product_title, ru.nick_name reviewee_nick_name FROM trade_review r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.reviewer_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON r.reviewee_id = ru.user_id LEFT JOIN trade_order o ON r.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.product_id
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_review SET status = #{status} WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
